mapper.sql: id, order_id, order_no, order_amount, order_time, owner_user_id, owner_agent_id, owner_agent_name, target_agent_id, target_agent_name, relation_level, product_id, product_name, product_category_id, quantity, product_amount, performance_type, performance_amount, status, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY relation_level ASC
SELECT FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND relation_level = 0 ORDER BY order_time DESC
SELECT FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE target_agent_id = #{targetAgentId} ORDER BY order_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE target_agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND order_time < #{endTime} THEN performance_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalTeamPerformance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND order_time >= #{monthStart} AND order_time < #{endTime} THEN performance_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS currentMonthTeamPerformance FROM dms_order_performance_detail WHERE target_agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_order_performance_detail (order_id, order_no, order_amount, order_time, owner_user_id, owner_agent_id, owner_agent_name, target_agent_id, target_agent_name, relation_level, product_id, product_name, product_category_id, quantity, product_amount, performance_type, performance_amount, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderTime}, #{ownerUserId}, #{ownerAgentId}, #{ownerAgentName}, #{targetAgentId}, #{targetAgentName}, #{relationLevel}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productCategoryId}, #{quantity}, #{productAmount}, #{performanceType}, #{performanceAmount}, #{status}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO dms_order_performance_detail (order_id, order_no, order_amount, order_time, owner_user_id, owner_agent_id, owner_agent_name, target_agent_id, target_agent_name, relation_level, product_id, product_name, product_category_id, quantity, product_amount, performance_type, performance_amount, status, remark) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.orderNo}, #{item.orderAmount}, #{item.orderTime}, #{item.ownerUserId}, #{item.ownerAgentId}, #{item.ownerAgentName}, #{item.targetAgentId}, #{item.targetAgentName}, #{item.relationLevel}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productCategoryId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.productAmount}, #{item.performanceType}, #{item.performanceAmount}, #{item.status}, #{item.remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_order_performance_detail SET target_agent_id = #{newTargetAgentId}, target_agent_name = #{newTargetAgentName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND target_agent_id = #{oldTargetAgentId} AND relation_level > 0
